The 2025 revenue recovery to $24.6B was flattered by currency tailwinds, masking weaker organic performance, and the company faces structural headwinds from pricing programs in China (11% of sales) and U.S. Medicare reimbursement cuts. Net income fell by half from $7.2B to $3.6B over three years, indicating deteriorating earnings power despite gross profit growth from $14.0B to $14.5B. The business maintains strong cash generation ($6.4B operating cash flow) and consistent R&D investment ($1.6B), but visibility into organic growth recovery and the magnitude of regulatory pricing pressures remains unclear. At a P/E of 42.83x on declining earnings and uncertain growth, the risk/reward does not compel immediate deep diligence, but the quality franchise and potential for cycle recovery warrant monitoring for better entry points or clearer evidence of organic growth inflection.

Currency exchange rates positively impacted 2025 reported sales year-over-year due to U.S. dollar weakening against most major currencies, meaning organic revenue performance was weaker than the headline 2.9% growth suggests, and strengthening of the U.S. dollar in 2026 would adversely impact sales and results.
